subject: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@heliolabs.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW

Sophie — following up from last week's call. Per Helio's growth plan (attached projection), you expect production traffic to ramp quickly across US and EU with a pilot in Singapore for APAC. To keep the onboarding timeline tight, we need to align on three items so our capacity team can size pools and give a firm onboarding date:

1) Target latency SLOs (p50/p95) for inference across regions
2) Expected sustained vs burst TPS/RPS during peak product launches (sample hourly profile works)
3) Commitment horizon / tranche preference (12m/24m and whether you want reserved vs burst billing)

Attached: helio-projection-q4.xlsx (traffic model) and draft-sow-helio.pdf (SOW with initial milestones).

Quick ask for internal folks: Laura, can you confirm recommended model family (LlamaX-70b-dev/quant) and whether a quantized variant is acceptable for APAC pilot? Irene — can you start a rough node/sku mapping for the three-region scenario (sustained + 2x burst) and note any sourcing constraints for Singapore? Monica — can you draft a minimal onboarding runbook (network, KMS, compliance checkpoints) that we can share with Helio Ops?

Goal: provide Helio with a capacity proposal and a Singapore pilot timeline by EOW.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0199
From: Sophie Tran <sophie@heliolabs.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Ops <ops@heliolabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear asks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency targets: p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 220ms for user-facing gen endpoints. For batch embedding jobs, p95 may be higher (we can throttle).
- Traffic: our Q4 plan assumes a steady baseline of ~35 RPS US + 25 RPS EU, with marketing-driven ramp days up to ~200 RPS across the fleet for short windows (~1-3 hours). APAC pilot (Singapore) will start at 10 RPS steady with occasional bursts to 40 RPS.
- Commitment: Helio prefers a 12 month reserved tranche with a 3-month ramp; we're open to a hybrid (reserved baseline + burst credits).

Also important: EU data residency for EU traffic and contract requirement for audit logging (SOC2 audit record references). Please include that in your sizing and SOW.

If you need a traffic sample CSV, I can push one to your Drive folder this afternoon.

Cheers,
Sophie
Head of ML Ops, Helio Labs
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie@heliolabs.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 22:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW

Sophie — thanks, that profile is helpful. Quick replies and internal notes below.

- Model family: Based on Helio's latency targets, recommended serving stack is a 70B quantized (int8) variant for the user-facing endpoints; keep one full-fp16 replica in each region for fallback and evals.
- Singapore pilot: acceptable to use lower-cost T4/H100 mix depending on availability — but H100 will be needed for peak burst windows to meet p95 on long prompts.
- EU residency: we'll pin EU traffic to our Frankfurt pool and enable audit logging. Monica, please add EU KMS keying and audit retention to the onboarding checklist.

Irene — can you map 3 sizing scenarios: conservative (baseline + 1.5x burst), expected (baseline + 2x burst), aggressive (baseline + 3x burst). Include GPU type assumptions per region and a procurement note for Singapore where capacity is constrained. If you can return an initial csv by tomorrow morning, we can present numbers to Helio in the Thursday sync.

I'll patch the SOW to reflect 12 month tranche + 3 month ramp and the residency requirement, then share updated doc with Sophie and ops.

- Laura
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 07:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW

Attached is a back-of-envelope sizing csv (capacity-scenarios-helio.csv). Summary below (expected scenario):

- US (us-west): baseline 35 RPS -> 6 sustained H100 nodes (4 v100-equivalent per node for our optimized serving), burst to 200 RPS -> up to 22 nodes during peak windows
- EU (frankfurt): baseline 25 RPS -> 4 sustained A100 nodes, burst up to 18 nodes
- APAC (singapore pilot): baseline 10 RPS -> 2 mixed nodes (1 H100 + 1 T4 for cost balance), burst to 40 RPS -> 6 nodes total

Notes/assumptions:
- Average prompt length assumed at 350 tokens; embeddings and batch jobs are colocated on separate queues and excluded from these node counts.
- Quantized model reduces memory footprint and allows +33% per-node throughput; latency estimates assume optimized kernels and a 128-token response window for user flows.
- Singapore sourcing: current spot availability shows 40% lower supply and 12-18% price premium vs frk/us-west. If Helio wants a guaranteed pilot window in July, we need a 4-week procurement lead and a signed tranche by June 15.

Action request: Karthik — confirm Helio is comfortable with the procurement lead time and pricing premium for Singapore pilot so we can lock SKU procurement.

- Irene
Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@heliolabs.ai>, Helio Ops <ops@heliolabs.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity footprint & Singapore pilot ask — Helio Labs SOW

Great progress, team — and thanks for the fast turnaround, Irene. Sophie — short next steps so we have alignment: 

1) I will update the SOW to include the 12m tranche + 3m ramp, EU data residency clause, and a procurement contingency for Singapore (price premium + 4-week lead). Draft SOW will be in the Drive link and DocuSign prep by EOD Friday.
2) If Helio signs the tranche by June 15, we guarantee the Singapore pilot window in July; otherwise pilot will be scheduled Q3 based on procurement cadence.
3) Irene will finalize a recommended node mix and committed node counts per region after we receive the traffic CSV Sophie mentioned.
4) Monica to prepare onboarding runbook (network/KMS/audit) and a SCIM-based access plan for Helio engineers.

Sophie — can you confirm by Monday that Helio is comfortable with the supplier premium and June 15 commitment cutoff? If yes, I will circulate DocuSign and a concise procurement timeline.

Links: updated SOW (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cHelioOnboard
DocuSign preview — https://app.docusign.com/helio-sow-draft

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-sow-helio.pdf (updated), helio-projection-q4.xlsx (traffic), capacity-scenarios-helio.csv (sizing)
